name: unified-intel-platform
description: Shell that runs World Monitor and God's Eye View side by side, unmodified, under one domain.

scripts.install:all: npm run install:world && npm run install:gev && npm install
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n world,gev,proxy -c amber,green,cyan "npm run dev:world" "npm run dev:gev" "npm run dev:proxy"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:world && npm run build:gev
